[[File:Minigame Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Minigame Teleport''' is a spell available on all [[spellbooks]] which provides players with a free [[teleport]] every twenty minutes to a [[minigame]] of their choice. Although Minigame Teleport is listed as one spell in a player's spellbook, attempting to cast the spell opens an interface asking you to choose from 21 different minigames. The spell requires no [[runes]] but takes 24 (or 18 with [[Speedy teleport scroll|Speedy]]) [[ticks]] (around 14 seconds or 10 seconds with Speedy) to cast. The teleport can be interrupted at any time by most actions, including combat. If a player tries to cast a minigame teleport a second time before 20 minutes have elapsed, they are notified with the remaining time in minutes in the chat box.

Minigame teleports may also be cast from the [[Grouping]] tab and share the same cooldown.

Minigame teleports cannot be cast from PvP worlds, the [[Wilderness]], player-owned houses, [[Emir's Arena]], or from various other minigames.
